title: Sideways recursion two levels deep, as YOY% uses YOY and PY

source.quote: For example, YOY% references both YOY and PY.
source.supports: an item may refer to items that refer to others of the same group

derivation: Ratio = DIVIDE ( Diff, Double ) = DIVIDE ( -60, 120 ) = -0.5. DIVIDE returns a decimal number (double).
